# media-amazon.com
> Amazon’s media delivery domain for static assets, images, scripts, stylesheets, and other content used across Amazon web properties.

This domain primarily serves CDN-hosted media and static resources rather than human-oriented documentation or product content. It does not appear to provide a conventional navigable documentation site, API reference, blog, or guides. The links below point to representative root and asset-serving paths commonly used on the domain and its subdomains.

## Domain Roots
- [media-amazon.com](https://media-amazon.com/): Root domain for Amazon-hosted media delivery and static asset distribution.
- [images-na.ssl-images-amazon.com](https://images-na.ssl-images-amazon.com/): Common Amazon image CDN host serving product and site imagery.
- [m.media-amazon.com](https://m.media-amazon.com/): Media host frequently used for Amazon images and static content.
- [g-ecx.images-amazon.com](https://g-ecx.images-amazon.com/): Legacy Amazon image host used for product and merchandising assets.
- [z-ecx.images-amazon.com](https://z-ecx.images-amazon.com/): Legacy Amazon image CDN endpoint for static visual assets.

## Image Asset Paths
- [Images directory](https://images-na.ssl-images-amazon.com/images/): Base path commonly used for image asset storage and retrieval.
- [G images directory](https://images-na.ssl-images-amazon.com/images/G/): Common namespace for Amazon global image assets.
- [M media images](https://m.media-amazon.com/images/): Base image path on Amazon’s media host.
- [P product images](https://m.media-amazon.com/images/P/): Common path pattern for product image assets.
- [I image assets](https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/): Common path pattern for individual image objects and variants.

## Static Site Assets
- [G static assets](https://images-na.ssl-images-amazon.com/images/G/01/): Namespace often used for shared site graphics and resources.
- [Navigation assets](https://images-na.ssl-images-amazon.com/images/G/01/nav2/): Static assets associated with Amazon navigation interfaces.
- [CSS assets](https://images-na.ssl-images-amazon.com/images/G/01/browser-scripts/): Path pattern used for browser scripts and frontend resources.
- [Shared frontend assets](https://images-na.ssl-images-amazon.com/images/G/01/x-locale/): Locale-specific static resources for Amazon web experiences.

## JavaScript and Frontend Resources
- [M media root](https://m.media-amazon.com/): Host used for frontend-delivered media and supporting assets.
- [Images namespace](https://m.media-amazon.com/images/): Shared namespace for image and related frontend asset delivery.
- [Legacy image CDN root](https://g-ecx.images-amazon.com/): Legacy endpoint for frontend image retrieval.
- [Legacy secure image CDN root](https://z-ecx.images-amazon.com/): Alternate legacy endpoint for secure static asset delivery.

## Regional and Legacy Hosts
- [SSL images host](https://images-na.ssl-images-amazon.com/): North America–oriented secure image delivery endpoint.
- [ECX image host](https://g-ecx.images-amazon.com/): Historical ECX image host still referenced by Amazon properties.
- [Alternate ECX image host](https://z-ecx.images-amazon.com/): Alternate historical ECX host for image distribution.
- [Media host](https://m.media-amazon.com/): Current general-purpose media host for Amazon assets.

## Usage Notes
- [Root media domain](https://media-amazon.com/): Domain is intended for asset delivery, not end-user documentation browsing.
- [Image CDN host](https://images-na.ssl-images-amazon.com/): Representative CDN endpoint for static images embedded across Amazon sites.
- [Media CDN host](https://m.media-amazon.com/): Representative CDN endpoint for newer media asset URLs.
- [Legacy CDN host](https://g-ecx.images-amazon.com/): Representative legacy endpoint retained for compatibility with older asset references.
